findings.issue: פָּרֹכֶת is a common noun (veil/curtain), not a name. “parójet” leaves that lemma untranslated.
דַּקָּה is feminine singular “fine/thin” and qualifies קְטֹרֶת. “molida” means ground and is placed on plural “especias”.
מְלֹא is a singular construct noun “fullness of”, smoothed to the adjectives “lleno” and “llenos” without a change of quantity.

notes: 3ms futures, Jehová, coals of fire, from upon the altar, and from before Jehová match the tokens.
